newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria Afprint says fire wont hit results.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria Afprint says fire wont hit results.

text.p: Textiles group Afprint on Thursday said a fire that destroyed a warehouse in a subsidiary on January 5 would not affect its financial result.
In a statement read on the trading floor of the Nigerian stock exchange, the company said the fire destroyed goods worth 237 million naira but pointed out that the goods were insured.
"It is not expected to affect our financial result in view of the insurance cover," the statement said.
It said the cause of the fire, which occurred at midnight in a warehouse belonging to Afcott, a subsidiary involved in cotton growing and processing of vegetable oil, was under investigation.
A report in one local newspaper said company officials suspected arson but this could not be immediately confirmed.
Afprint said its operations and investments valued at more than two billion naira were unaffected.
Traders, however, reacted by dropping its share price on the stock market on Thursday. It closed 2.60 naira, five kobo down.
